datasets.title: NOAA NYC-area station climate context, 1991–2025
limitations: A five-year recent period is weather/climate context, not a new 30-year normal or attribution study.
Station siting, relocations, observation practices, airport/park surroundings and ocean proximity affect comparisons.
Daily temperature and precipitation do not provide humidity, heat index, WBGT, cooling peaks, subdaily rainfall, flood depth or financial losses.
No 2026 observations are included; no station values are forecasts or parcel-scale measurements.
Unadjusted derived baseline statistics are not official NOAA Climate Normals.
Raw source includes 2026 through October 24 but these partial-year records are excluded from the analytical products.

daily_archive.note: Lossless downloadable archive. Decompression restores the unchanged daily station CSV; the application uses the existing aggregate JSON assets.

datasets.title: NPCC4 temperature and precipitation change
datasets.spatial_support: NYC metropolitan/regional climate context; not parcel-specific output
limitations: Do not add these 1981-2010 changes directly to the separate 1991-2020 station baseline; rebase using consistent observations and methods first.
The 25th-75th percentile interval is model/scenario spread, not a confidence interval for a building.
Pooled percentiles combine two scenarios; choose scenario_ensemble_means only when explicitly presenting scenario-specific means.
Raw GCMs include models with high climate sensitivity; NPCC discusses the hot-model issue and comparison with constrained subsets.
Annual precipitation percent changes do not scale hourly rainfall, flood depth, property losses, or drainage design storms.
No parcel differentiation, building indoor temperatures, cooling bills, or flood inundation is derived here.

datasets.title: NPCC4 regional extreme temperature and rain-day frequency
datasets.spatial_support: NYC metropolitan/regional climate context; not parcel-specific output
limitations: Model/scenario spread is not calibrated probability.
30-year mean event frequencies are not single-year forecasts.
Daily rain thresholds do not measure hourly rain intensity.
Sea-level values exist in preserved source but are not normalized in this climate product.

datasets.title: NOAA paired airport temperature and dew point, 2021–2025
datasets.spatial_support: JFK, LaGuardia and Newark airport outdoor reference stations; no Central Park or building observations
limitations: Airport outdoor observations are regional context, not measurements at a selected property or inside a building.
Five complete requested calendar years have small reported gaps after conservative filtering; this is not a 30-year climate normal or an engineering design-weather series.
Dew point adds observed atmospheric-moisture context. These records alone do not establish latent cooling load, electrical capacity, equipment size, operating cost, health risk, or site suitability.
All sample timestamps are UTC. UTC calendar boundaries differ from New York local dates; values were not shifted to local-day summaries.
No climate-change attribution, synthetic future hourly weather, interpolation, heat index, wet-bulb estimate, or load model is produced.
Source data may be revised. Each station-year source URL, retrieval time, Last-Modified value, and SHA-256 hash is retained.
Legacy ISD/Global Hourly stopped updating after August 24, 2025. This consistent 2021–2025 acquisition uses NOAA’s GHCNh successor instead.

method.pairing: Both readings must be in the same station/timestamp row, with routine FM15 report type and accepted quality/source codes for each value.
method.quality_policy: Conservative project policy: retain explicitly good documented legacy QC only. Blank/unclassified, suspect, erroneous, gross-limit-only, validator-edited and other codes are excluded, even when NOAA may accept a flagged value. This is not a claim that excluded values are wrong.
method.hour_selection: At most one eligible FM15 pair per UTC clock hour; select the minute closest to :51, the observed modal routine report minute at all three stations; ties choose earlier timestamp. No averaging, interpolation, or special-report substitution.
method.coverage: Selected paired samples divided by all UTC hour bins in the calendar year/month. A represented hour is one sampled moment, not complete continuous coverage.
method.hot_run: A descriptive project threshold of dry-bulb temperature ≥30°C at selected samples in at least three consecutive UTC hour bins. Missing/invalid hours or a cooler sample end a run. This is not an official heat-wave definition or continuous exposure duration.
method.episode_order: Top three qualifying runs per station-year, ordered by peak selected temperature, then number of consecutive bins, then start time. All selected observations remain in the local audit CSV.
method.peak_ties: Among selected paired observations, count every tie for the station-year maximum and display the earliest UTC observation. Its coincident companion reading belongs to that timestamp; it may differ at other tied maxima.
method.quantiles: Type-7 linear empirical sample quantiles, rounded to the underlying 0.1°C reporting precision. Quantiles are descriptive, not engineering design percentiles.
method.physical_guard: Exclude non-finite/sentinel/out-of-sanity-range values and pairs with dew point greater than dry-bulb temperature; no substitution.
method.central_park: Not included; this supplemental acquisition intentionally covers the three verified airport stations only.

references.title: Local Climate Zones for Urban Temperature Studies

references.title: New York City Impacts on a Regional Heat Wave
references.role: Urban processes during a specific 2010 heatwave; not a fixed universal building offset.
references.implementation_scope: Specific NYC heatwave mechanism study; simulations were not rerun and their temperature effects are not assigned to buildings.

references.title: High-resolution projections of extreme heat in New York City
references.role: Urban-scale dynamical downscaling and bias correction; no direct parcel/indoor guarantee.
references.implementation_scope: Research example with 1 km urban modeling; its grid outputs were not acquired or connected as parcel projections.

references.title: NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6
references.role: 0.25-degree daily statistical projections; copying grid values to buildings does not add resolution.
references.implementation_scope: Researched 0.25-degree statistical-downscaling extension only; NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 arrays were not acquired or connected.

references.title: Towards process-informed bias correction of climate change simulations
references.role: Bias correction needs physical-process awareness and does not restore missing processes.
references.implementation_scope: Interpretation of process and bias-correction limits; no bias-correction model was fitted in the application.

references.title: A case-only study of vulnerability to heat wave-related mortality in New York City (2000–2011)
references.role: Health vulnerability and asset engineering suitability use different outcomes.
references.implementation_scope: Supports the distinction between resident health vulnerability and asset suitability; it is not the exact 2024 HVI construction algorithm or a warehouse response model.

date_semantics.retrieved_on: Acquisition date, never a substitute for observation date.
date_semantics.source_latest_record_date: Most recent observed date in preserved raw source; may exceed analytical cutoff.
date_semantics.source_rows_updated_at: Publisher catalog update timestamp, not an observation date.
date_semantics.projection_horizons: Modeled climate time windows; not actual observation dates.

stormwater_duration_verification.caution: One-hour rainfall scenario wording does not establish a constant within-hour hyetograph or full model simulation duration. Do not substitute the separate NPCC3 coastal flood layer +31-inch assumption for the stormwater map +30-inch assumption.

reference_summary.scope: Counts describe a selected bibliography, not a systematic review, independent replications, acquired data layers, or validations of a building-level model.
reference_summary.doi_verification: All 14 DOI/title/year records checked against Crossref registration on 2026-10-28; publisher/authoritative sources checked for citation scope. HTTP access errors are not treated as invalid DOIs.

independent_audit.method: Independent preserved-native-file reconstruction; no production aggregator imported.
independent_audit.limitations: Internal consistency does not establish sensor accuracy, homogenization or building-level predictive skill.
